canDo: Can ask who a person is or what a thing is and answer with c'est.
label: Ask who someone is or what something is

canDo: Can ask for and give their age, nationality, address and where they live.
label: Ask for and give personal details

canDo: Can say what they usually do and when, and ask others about their day.
label: Talk about your day and your timetable

canDo: Can ask what time it is and understand or give the answer.
label: Ask and tell the time

canDo: Can say what day and date it is and when something happens.
label: Say the day and the date

canDo: Can count, and give and understand numbers such as ages, prices and phone numbers.
label: Count and use numbers

canDo: Can say roughly how much of something there is, or that there is too much.
label: Say how much or how many

canDo: Can say what someone looks like and what they are like, in short sentences.
label: Ask about and describe people

canDo: Can say what a place is like and what there is in it.
label: Ask about and describe places

canDo: Can say what an object is like, such as its size or age.
label: Ask about and describe things

canDo: Can ask simple questions to find out where something is or whether it exists.
label: Ask for information

canDo: Can ask how to get somewhere and follow or give simple directions.
label: Ask for and give directions

canDo: Can say how they travel and where they are going.
label: Talk about and use transport

canDo: Can say what they like and do not like doing.
label: Say what you like and dislike

canDo: Can say what they want or would like.
label: Say what you want

canDo: Can say what they are able to do and what they know how to do.
label: Say what you can and cannot do

canDo: Can say what they are going to do soon.
label: Talk about plans

canDo: Can say they do not know something.
label: Say you do not know

canDo: Can catch a stranger's attention politely and ask them for something.
label: Approach someone and ask for something

canDo: Can invite someone to do something and offer them food or drink.
label: Invite someone or offer something

canDo: Can tell someone to do something and follow short instructions.
label: Give and follow simple instructions

canDo: Can ask for what they want in a shop, ask the price and pay.
label: Buy things and ask the price

canDo: Can order food and drink and ask for the bill.
label: Order in a café or restaurant

canDo: Can book a table for a number of people at a given time.
label: Book a table or a room

canDo: Can set a time to meet, and move or cancel it.
label: Make, move or cancel an appointment

canDo: Can say hello and goodbye in a way that fits the time of day and the person.
label: Greet people and say goodbye

canDo: Can thank someone for something.
label: Say thank you

canDo: Can say sorry for a small mistake.
label: Say sorry

canDo: Can ask how someone is, say how they are, and ask after someone else.
label: Ask how someone is and pass on news

canDo: Can say their name and something simple about themselves.
label: Introduce yourself

canDo: Can introduce a friend or a family member to someone else.
label: Introduce someone

canDo: Can wish someone a good day or a happy birthday and pay a simple compliment.
label: Give good wishes and compliments

canDo: Can say yes to an invitation, or say no politely and give a short reason.
label: Accept or turn down an invitation

canDo: Can link words and short sentences with et, mais, ou and alors.
label: Join simple ideas

canDo: Can say they did not understand and ask someone to repeat or speak more slowly.
label: Say you did not understand

canDo: Can ask what a word or phrase means.
label: Ask what a word means

canDo: Can ask someone to spell a word, and spell their own name.
label: Ask how a word is spelled

canDo: Can say what job they do, where, and what their work involves.
label: Talk about your work

canDo: Can tell what they did and what happened, in order, with the passé composé.
label: Tell what happened

canDo: Can describe people, places and habits in the past.
label: Describe how things used to be

canDo: Can say a few things about a town or country and the people who live there.
label: Present a town or a country

canDo: Can say they are hungry, cold, tired or in pain.
label: Say how you feel physically

canDo: Can say that one thing is bigger, better or more expensive than another.
label: Compare people and things

canDo: Can give a few facts about a person's life and say how people are related.
label: Describe someone's life and family ties

canDo: Can say that someone is right, or that something is not true.
label: Agree or disagree

canDo: Can say what they think about something in a simple sentence.
label: Give an opinion

canDo: Can explain why they do something or why they chose it.
label: Give a reason

canDo: Can say they are not sure, or that they are against an idea.
label: Express doubt or objection

canDo: Can say whether they liked a film, a meal or an outing.
label: Say what you enjoyed or did not enjoy

canDo: Can say that something interests them, or that they do not mind.
label: Show interest or indifference

canDo: Can say what is necessary or what someone must do.
label: Say what someone has to do

canDo: Can ask someone for help, and offer to help someone else.
label: Ask for help or offer it

canDo: Can suggest an outing and respond to someone else's suggestion.
label: Suggest something to do

canDo: Can agree with others on what has to be done and who does it.
label: Plan something together

canDo: Can ask what to do and tell someone what they should do.
label: Ask for and give advice

canDo: Can warn someone of a danger or tell them to be careful.
label: Warn someone

canDo: Can open a short conversation with someone and close it politely.
label: Start and end a conversation

canDo: Can answer the phone, say who is calling and ask for someone.
label: Make a simple phone call

canDo: Can tell events in order with first, then, after that and finally.
label: Put events in order

canDo: Can ask what someone means and ask for more detail.
label: Ask someone to explain

canDo: Can check whether the other person has understood.
label: Check that you are understood

canDo: Can interrupt politely to say they missed something.
label: Interrupt politely to ask again

canDo: Can pass on what someone else said or asked.
label: Report what someone said

canDo: Can say what they would do if things were different.
label: Talk about an imagined situation

canDo: Can tell a memory or story, setting the scene and then saying what happened.
label: Tell a memory or a story

canDo: Can say how they feel about something and ask about others' feelings.
label: Talk about feelings

canDo: Can say what they wish for, hope for and intend to do.
label: Talk about hopes, wishes and plans for the future

canDo: Can give their view and back it up with a reason or an example.
label: Give and support an opinion

canDo: Can say what is possible or likely and make simple guesses.
label: Make a guess about what is true

canDo: Can say what they thought of a film, book or show and why.
label: Give your view of a film or book

canDo: Can say they are satisfied or unhappy with something and complain politely.
label: Say you are pleased or make a complaint

canDo: Can describe a problem and suggest what to do about it.
label: Raise a problem and suggest a solution

canDo: Can ask and answer prepared questions in an interview, for example for a job.
label: Take part in an interview

canDo: Can give a short, prepared talk about a topic or a project.
label: Give a short talk on a topic

canDo: Can tell the main points of a story or an article and say what they think of it.
label: Sum up a story and comment on it

canDo: Can say why something happened and what it led to.
label: Explain cause and effect

canDo: Can say they want to speak, join in a discussion and bring up a new point.
label: Join a discussion and change the subject

canDo: Can point back to something said earlier with words like the first, the last, the next.
label: Refer back to something already said

canDo: Can bring a talk or discussion to an end.
label: Wrap up what you are saying

canDo: Can put something another way to make it clearer.
label: Say something again in other words

canDo: Can repeat back what someone said to make sure they understood it.
label: Repeat what someone said to check it
